high_level_description: The image is a collage of various social media posts and articles related to deep learning and artificial intelligence (AI). Title: "The scaling assumption never made sense to me" Content: A screenshot of an article titled "Deep Learning Is Hitting a Wall" by Gary Marcus. The article discusses the limitations of deep learning, particularly the scaling assumption, which is compared to Moore's law.
